title: Catalog of General Ethical Requirements for AI Certification

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure this bias itself, but establishes a normative certification framework requiring developers to use statistical (e.g., disparate impact) and causal analysis to detect and mitigate racial bias and profiling.

The paper does not empirically conduct evaluations, but proposes a normative framework requiring developers to use statistical parity and causal inference approaches to identify and mitigate gender stereotypes in AI outputs.
The paper presents a normative framework that requires developers to use statistical and causal bias analysis methodologies to detect and mitigate age-related discrimination.
The paper establishes a normative certification framework requiring AI developers to utilize statistical and causal methodologies to evaluate and prevent disparities based on socioeconomic status.
